name: tracker-native-piped-json
goal: Native harness tracker --json output reaches a piped reader whole (no truncation at the 64 KiB pipe buffer), so tracker-alert.py and agents can parse list --flagged --json after the cutover

evidence: Failing: native 'harness tracker list --flagged --json' read through a pipe stops at 64 KiB multiples (294912/262145/360449/98304 of 418376 bytes against a staged hub copy, 01:17Z); file redirect is whole. Expected: whole JSON for piped readers such as ~/chief-of-staff/bin/tracker-alert.py. Repro: compiled harness cf47b4ea37 against a native hub rehearsal copy.

The existing piped-JSON case in test/cli-output.e2e.test.ts covers 'units graph' only, which goes through the commander path after pipedOutput(). The tracker fast path in runCli returned before pipedOutput(), and the native tracker tests (tracker-node e2e) read short outputs, so none crossed 64 KiB through a pipe. Added: native tracker case with a loopback API fixture (test/support/trackerNativeJsonFixture.ts) returning >256 KiB.
